1	# CLAUDE.md
2	
3	This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.
4	* Always update docs/USER_GUIDE.md if something changed.
5	
6	## Repository Overview
7	
8	Andes hybrid RISC-V co-simulator: QEMU 9.x (functional, MHz-level) + vsim (SystemC + Verilator, cycle-accurate) share architectural state across a magic-CSR boundary. The system runs a three-phase round-trip: **QEMU1** (drain on CSR/PC trigger) -> **vsim** (resume + execute + drain) -> **QEMU2** (restore via gdbstub, continue).
9	
10	Two Git submodules:
11	- `QEMU/` - QEMU fork hosting the TCG plugin (branch: `hybrid`)
12	- `verilator/` - vsim sources; `hybrid/` subdirs hold the plugin and test fixtures
13	- `tools/simpoint/` - SimPoint 3.2 (UCSD) clustering binary; pinned to upstream `17783e5`
14	
15	Shared ABI lives at `include/hybrid/state_abi.h` (not inside either submodule).
16	
17	## Build Commands
18	
19	**Primary path (`./hsim`)** -- the end-user driver, used in all user-facing docs:
20	
21	```sh
22	./hsim build                       # builds qemu, vsim, plugin, simpoint, fixtures
23	./hsim test                        # full e2e suite (defaults: MODE=both, JOBS=8)
24	./hsim run <elf> --mode csr|pc|icount|slice  # one round-trip
25	./hsim list <fixtures|demos|modes>
26	```
27	
28	**Developer escape hatch** -- the underlying scripts. Use these when
29	working on the build system, the harness, or a single leg in isolation:
30	
31	```sh
32	# Build everything (qemu -> vsim -> plugin -> simpoint)
33	source ./setup.sh
34	
35	# Build individual components
36	./scripts/build_qemu.sh                              # QEMU (configure + make -j64)
37	./scripts/build_vsim.sh                              # vsim (Docker/podman, runs ./build.sh inside container)
38	make -C qemu_plugin QEMU_ROOT=./QEMU  # TCG plugin (out-of-tree)
39	./scripts/build_simpoint.sh                          # SimPoint clustering binary (g++ on host)
40	
41	# Build RISC-V ELF test fixtures
42	make -C tests/fixtures              # all fixtures
43	make -C tests/fixtures rt_c_v_regs.elf  # single fixture
44	
45	# Clean
46	source ./setup.sh clean [qemu|vsim|plugin|simpoint|all]
47	```
48	
49	**Outputs:**
50	- `build/qemu/qemu-system-riscv64`
51	- `verilator/build/sim_ax45mpv_premium` (or other CPU variant)
52	- `qemu_plugin/libhybrid_handoff.so`
53	- `tools/simpoint/bin/simpoint`
54	
55	`scripts/build_vsim.sh` is Docker-based (podman). It builds an image from `verilator/Dockerfile` (target `env`) then runs `./build.sh` inside it, mounting the repo at `/work` and `include/` as `/include:ro`.
56	
57	## Running Tests
58	
59	```sh
60	# All e2e tests in parallel (auto-detects job count from nproc + /dev/shm headroom)
61	bash scripts/run_e2e.sh
62	
63	# Run with specific options
64	JOBS=4 MODE=csr bash scripts/run_e2e.sh         # 4-way parallel, CSR-mode only
65	JOBS=1 bash scripts/run_e2e.sh                  # sequential (debug)
66	FILTER=rt_c_v bash scripts/run_e2e.sh           # regex filter on fixture name
67	LOG_DIR=/tmp/my-logs bash scripts/run_e2e.sh    # custom log directory
68	
69	# Unit tests (inside vsim build container)
70	# The container build runs: cmake --build build -j
71	# To run ctest directly after build:
72	#   podman run ... ./build.sh && podman exec ... ctest --test-dir build -L hybrid-e2e
73	```
74	
75	**Important:** on a high-core-count machine (128+ cores) `default_jobs()` computes `min(nproc, /dev/shm_free/256MB)` which can reach 128+. Running that many vsim Verilator processes simultaneously saturates CPU and causes timeouts. Use `JOBS=8` (or lower) as a practical cap: `JOBS=8 bash scripts/run_e2e.sh`.
76	
77	`scripts/run_e2e.sh` exits 0 only when all tests pass. Logs go to a `mktemp` directory under `/tmp`; path is printed at the start of each run. Each test's full output lands in `$LOG_DIR/$mode--$name.log`.
78	
79	**Manual driver tests**: `tests/hsim/test_hsim_*.sh` are per-feature RED-then-green smoke tests for `./hsim` subcommands (F1..F14). They are run manually during driver development, not wired into `scripts/run_e2e.sh`. Each script is self-contained (sources `setup.sh` artifacts, runs one subcommand, asserts on stdout). The same convention applies to `tests/plugin/test_plugin_*.sh` (QEMU-plugin-only smoke tests).
80	
81	## Architecture
82	
83	### Three-Phase Handoff
84	
85	```
86	QEMU1 --(state file)--> vsim --(state file + V-scratch mmap)--> QEMU2
87	```
88	
89	1. **QEMU plugin** (`qemu_plugin/hybrid_handoff.c`) - TCG plugin. On CSR-write trigger (`csrwi 0x7C0, 0`) or PC-trigger, drains QEMU's architectural state into a binary `hybrid_state_v1` struct written to `--outfile`.
90	2. **vsim handoff controller** (`src/hybrid/handoff_controller.hpp`) - Detects the trigger inside vsim, pauses the hart via DMI, then calls `ResumeDriver` to restore state.
91	3. **ResumeDriver** (`src/hybrid/resume_driver.hpp`) - Writes GPRs/FPRs/CSRs/V-state into the vsim hart via RISC-V Debug Module Abstract Commands and Program Buffer.
92	4. **StateDrain** (`src/hybrid/state_drain.hpp`) - On vsim exit trigger, reads back the full architectural state via DMI Abstract Commands.
93	5. **qemu_handback** (`src/hybrid/qemu_handback.hpp`) - Spawns QEMU2, connects via gdbstub, sends P-packet register writes for GPRs/FPRs/CSRs/V-regs, then `continue`s.
94	
95	**CSR restore split**: `ResumeDriver` writes only the CSRs that the vsim phase can touch: `mstatus`, `mtvec`, `mcycle`, `minstret`. The QEMU plugin still drains the full M-mode set (`mepc`, `mcause`, `mtval`, `mscratch`, `medeleg`, `mideleg`, `mip`, `mie`, `satp`) plus PMP (64 `pmpaddr` + 16 `pmpcfg`) into `hybrid_state_v1`, but those are restored only on QEMU2 via the gdbstub P-packet path in `qemu_handback`. The vsim phase is assumed trap-free and PMP-static; if a future workload needs traps or dynamic PMP inside the ROI, `ResumeDriver` must be extended.
96	
97	### Trigger Modes
98	
99	- **CSR mode** (default): Pattern-matches `csrwi 0x7C0, 0` (entry) / `csrwi 0x7C0, 1` (exit) at retire time. CSR 0x7C0 is a benign vendor write on Andes ax45mp.
100	- **PC mode**: ELF symbols `_hybrid_enter_pc` / `_hybrid_exit_pc` resolved at startup; CSR insns are bypassed.
101	
102	Both modes coexist in the fixtures. `TRIGGER_MODE=csr|pc` selects at runtime.
103	
104	### Shared ABI (`include/hybrid/state_abi.h`)
105	
106	`hybrid_state_v1` is the binary wire format exchanged between QEMU plugin, vsim, and the handback path. It holds: 32 GPRs, 32 FPRs, M-mode CSRs (mstatus, mepc, etc.), PMP (64 pmpaddr + 16 pmpcfg), and the V extension block (vstart, vtype, vl, vlenb, 32 vreg[], vxsat, vxrm, vcsr). `HYBRID_VLEN_BYTES_MAX=64` supports VLEN up to 512 bits. Multi-byte fields are little-endian (native on RV64 + x86-64 host); the format is not endian-portable.
107	
108	Flags (`HYBRID_FLAG_RV64`, `HYBRID_FLAG_FP`, `HYBRID_FLAG_V`) gate which state blocks are live. The ABI struct is validated by `tests/hybrid/state_abi.test.cpp`.
109	
110	### V-State Transport
111	
112	V data registers (v0..v31) move through a fixed scratch region
113	(`kVScratchGpa = 0x00FF0000` on `-M andes_ae350`) in the shared mmap. vsim drives
114	the transfer via the Debug Module **Program Buffer** while the hart is halted, so
115	benchmark binaries issue no transport code:
116	- `stage_v_to_scratch` copies `hybrid_state_v1::vreg[]` into the scratch region
117	  before resume; `ResumeDriver` then sweeps `vle8.v v0..v31` from scratch into the
118	  regfile (`pb_v_data_sweep`, load=true).
119	- At drain, `StateDrain` sweeps `vse8.v v0..v31` from the regfile back to scratch
120	  (`pb_v_data_sweep`, load=false); `read_v_from_scratch` lifts the bytes into
121	  `hybrid_state_v1::vreg[]`.
122	- `qemu_handback` ships them to QEMU2 via gdbstub P-packets by register number.
123	
124	Each sweep leads with `vsetvl` to e8/m1 (vl=vlenb), which also forces vstart=0 so
125	the unit-stride access covers the whole register. The scratch stride is the
126	compile-time `HYBRID_VLEN_BYTES_MAX` (wire-format per-register span), not the
127	runtime vlenb.
128	
129	V scalar CSR transport (vtype, vl, vstart, vxsat, vxrm, vcsr):
130	- **Tier A** (Abstract Commands): vstart, vxsat, vxrm, vcsr, mstatus.VS
131	- **Tier B** (Program Buffer): vtype + vl via `vsetvl x0, x5, x6` (direct CSR write to vtype sets vill; vl is read-only; only `vsetvl` restores both atomically)
132	
133	Restore order in `ResumeDriver::resume()` when `HYBRID_FLAG_V` is set:
134	1. `mstatus.VS` (enables V in the hart)
135	2. V-data reload sweep: `vsetvl` e8/m1 then `vle8.v v0..v31` from scratch in the
136	   Program Buffer. Runs BEFORE the architectural V-CSR restore (whose `vsetvl`
137	   overwrites the sweep's vtype/vl/vstart) and uses x5/x6/x7 as scratch.
138	3. `vsetvl x0, x5, x6` in Program Buffer (stages `vl` in x5, `vtype` in x6 via abstract GPR writes first)
139	4. `vstart` (AFTER vsetvl: vsetvl resets vstart to 0)
140	5. `vxsat`, `vxrm`, `vcsr`
141	6. GPR loop (overwrites the x5/x6/x7 scratch - safe now)
142	
143	`StateDrain::drain_with_passthrough()` issues the matching `vse8.v` dump sweep
144	LAST, after every architectural read (GPRs/FPRs/V-CSRs/mcycle/minstret), so the
145	sweep's clobbers and any counter increments cannot corrupt the drained state.
146	
147	### Test Fixtures
148	
149	All fixtures run on the unified `tests/hybrid/e2e.sh` harness, which
150	sets up an `/dev/shm`-backed shared mmap (128 MB) so memory survives
151	the QEMU1 -> vsim -> QEMU2 round-trip. Two fixture families:
152	
153	| Family   | Examples                                                    | Notes |
154	|----------|-------------------------------------------------------------|-------|
155	| asm      | `handoff_roundtrip`, `rt_all_gprs`, `rt_csr_survival`, `rt_shared_mem` | no C runtime; don't strictly need shared mmap but use it anyway (~20 ms cost is negligible). |
156	| C-level  | `rt_c_hello`, `rt_c_matmul`, `rt_c_v_regs`, `rt_c_v_csrs`   | linked against vsim-demo C runtime. Shared mmap is REQUIRED -- the stack/heap and `main()`'s ra-spill/restore around `csrwi 0x7C0,1` must survive vsim -> QEMU2. |
157	
158	The shared mmap is created with `mktemp -p /dev/shm` + `truncate`,
159	then QEMU is launched with `-object memory-backend-file`.
160	
161	Fixture source lives in `tests/fixtures/`. C-level fixtures link `runtime/{crt0.S, trap.S, handler.c}` plus the Andes toolchain's `-lgloss_vh` (semihosting-backed libgloss), using `rt_c.ld`. V-using fixtures require `-march=rv64gcv`. **Phase-2 rule:** the span between `enter_vsim()` and `exit_vsim()` runs on vsim and MUST NOT issue any syscall (no `printf`, `fopen`, semihosting ebreak, etc.) -- vsim does not implement semihosting, so any libgloss-routed call inside the ROI traps. Phase 1 and phase 3 print via standard newlib stdio (both QEMUs are launched with `-semihosting-config enable=on,target=native`).
162	
163	### vsim CMake Structure
164	
165	vsim lives entirely in `verilator/`. Key CMake options:
166	- `VSIM_ENABLE_HYBRID` (default OFF) - enables e2e CTest registration
167	- `VSIM_CONFIG_FILE` - CPU YAML (default `config.yaml`)
168	- `VSIM_NO_VERILATOR` - skip Verilator build (assume prebuilt)
169	
170	The hybrid orchestration layer (`src/hybrid/*.hpp`) is header-only and depends only on C++20 standard library + the shared ABI header. SystemC/Verilator are not required for hybrid unit tests.
171	
172	Hybrid unit tests (`tests/hybrid/`) use [doctest](https://github.com/doctest/doctest). They are registered in `cmake/HybridConfig.cmake` and run via `ctest`. The `recording_bus.hpp` / `RecordingSession` patterns provide duck-typed test doubles for the DMI bus and gdbstub session without requiring virtual interfaces.
173	
174	## Key Files
175	
176	| File | Purpose |
177	|------|---------|
178	| `include/hybrid/state_abi.h` | Wire-format struct (shared by all three components) |
179	| `qemu_plugin/hybrid_handoff.c` | TCG plugin: drain on trigger |
180	| `verilator/src/hybrid/handoff_controller.hpp` | Phase dispatcher |
181	| `verilator/src/hybrid/resume_driver.hpp` | DMI state restore (Tier A+B) |
182	| `verilator/src/hybrid/state_drain.hpp` | DMI state capture |
183	| `verilator/src/hybrid/qemu_handback.hpp` | Spawn QEMU2, gdbstub P-packets |
184	| `verilator/src/hybrid/v_regfile_xfer.hpp` | V register transport via scratch region |
